title: W11169652 — Service Diagnostic mode entry
description: Identify UI type and enter Service Diagnostic mode (console 3-button or LCD password).

steps.title: Console control panel?
steps.body: Console models use membrane buttons and a seven-segment display. LCD-in-door models use the TOOLS menu and touchscreen — answer No for those.

steps.title: Console — enter Service Diagnostic mode
steps.body: Washer in standby (plugged in, indicators off). Wait 30 seconds after applying power. Choose any three buttons except POWER and remember them. Within 8 seconds, press and release button 1, then 2, then 3 — repeat that same 3-button sequence two more times (3 rounds total). Success: all console indicators illuminate for 5 seconds and the seven-segment display shows 888.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Select any three (3) buttons (except POWER)... Press and Release the 1st, 2nd, 3rd selected button; Repeat this 3 button sequence 2 more times.

steps.title: LCD — enter Service Diagnostic mode
steps.body: Washer in standby. Open and close the door. Press POWER until the home screen displays. Press TOOLS → scroll to INFO → SERVICE & SUPPORT. Press and hold DIAGNOSTICS until ENTER PASSWORD appears. Enter 123, 123, 123 and press ENTER. On the warning screen, touch ENTER to reach DIAGNOSTICS HOME.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press the TOOLS button. From the TOOLS menu, scroll down to INFO. From the INFO menu, select SERVICE & SUPPORT.
